from pathlib import Path


def replace_once(path, old, new):
    p = Path(path)
    text = p.read_text()
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"{path}: replacement count {count}, want 1")
    p.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))


replace_once(
    "glm-worker/internal/autoresume/codex_wake_transaction.go",
    '''\t\tcandidate, problem := readWakeTOML(path, entry.Name())
\t\tif problem != "" {
\t\t\treturn "", false, fmt.Errorf("wake automation candidate is not valid: %s", problem)
\t\t}
\t\tif candidate.TargetThreadID != wakeThreadID {
\t\t\treturn "", false, fmt.Errorf("wake automation candidate target changed during inventory: %s", candidate.ID)
\t\t}
\t\tmatches = append(matches, candidate.ID)
''',
    '''\t\tcandidate, problem := readWakeTOMLForThread(path, entry.Name(), wakeThreadID)
\t\tif problem != "" {
\t\t\treturn "", false, fmt.Errorf("wake automation candidate is not valid: %s", problem)
\t\t}
\t\tmatches = append(matches, candidate.ID)
''',
)
anchor = '''func resolveCodexWakeAutomation(automationRoot, wakeThreadID string) (string, bool, error) {\n'''
helper = '''func readWakeTOMLForThread(path, entryName, wakeThreadID string) (wakeAutomation, string) {
\tcandidate, problem := readWakeTOML(path, entryName)
\tif problem != "" {
\t\treturn candidate, problem
\t}
\tif candidate.TargetThreadID != wakeThreadID {
\t\treturn candidate, "target thread changed during inventory"
\t}
\treturn candidate, ""
}

'''
replace_once("glm-worker/internal/autoresume/codex_wake_transaction.go", anchor, helper + anchor)

old = '''func qualityWiringForbiddenCalls(check qualityWiringCheck, data []byte) ([]string, error) {
\tif len(check.forbiddenTokens) == 0 {
\t\treturn nil, nil
\t}
\tif !strings.HasSuffix(check.path, ".go") {
\t\tvar found []string
\t\ttext := string(data)
\t\tfor _, value := range check.forbiddenTokens {
\t\t\tif strings.Contains(text, value) {
\t\t\t\tfound = append(found, value)
\t\t\t}
\t\t}
\t\treturn found, nil
\t}
\tset := token.NewFileSet()
\tfile, err := parser.ParseFile(set, check.path, data, 0)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, err
\t}
\tfound := false
\tast.Inspect(file, func(node ast.Node) bool {
\t\tcall, ok := node.(*ast.CallExpr)
\t\tif !ok {
\t\t\treturn true
\t\t}
\t\tselector, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
\t\tif !ok || selector.Sel.Name != "Check" {
\t\t\treturn true
\t\t}
\t\tpkg, ok := selector.X.(*ast.Ident)
\t\tif ok && pkg.Name == "harnesslint" {
\t\t\tfound = true
\t\t}
\t\treturn true
\t})
\tif found {
\t\treturn []string{"harnesslint.Check"}, nil
\t}
\treturn nil, nil
}
'''
new = '''func qualityWiringForbiddenCalls(check qualityWiringCheck, data []byte) ([]string, error) {
\tif len(check.forbiddenTokens) == 0 {
\t\treturn nil, nil
\t}
\tif !strings.HasSuffix(check.path, ".go") {
\t\treturn qualityWiringForbiddenText(check.forbiddenTokens, data), nil
\t}
\treturn qualityWiringForbiddenGo(check.path, data)
}

func qualityWiringForbiddenText(values []string, data []byte) []string {
\tvar found []string
\ttext := string(data)
\tfor _, value := range values {
\t\tif strings.Contains(text, value) {
\t\t\tfound = append(found, value)
\t\t}
\t}
\treturn found
}

func qualityWiringForbiddenGo(path string, data []byte) ([]string, error) {
\tfile, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), path, data, 0)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, err
\t}
\tfound := false
\tast.Inspect(file, func(node ast.Node) bool {
\t\tif qualityWiringIsHarnessCheck(node) {
\t\t\tfound = true
\t\t}
\t\treturn true
\t})
\tif found {
\t\treturn []string{"harnesslint.Check"}, nil
\t}
\treturn nil, nil
}

func qualityWiringIsHarnessCheck(node ast.Node) bool {
\tcall, ok := node.(*ast.CallExpr)
\tif !ok {
\t\treturn false
\t}
\tselector, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
\tif !ok || selector.Sel.Name != "Check" {
\t\treturn false
\t}
\tpkg, ok := selector.X.(*ast.Ident)
\treturn ok && pkg.Name == "harnesslint"
}
'''
replace_once("glm-worker/internal/harnesslint/quality_surface.go", old, new)
